environment.description: NestJS microservice deployed on ECS Fargate in an isolated VPC (10.0.0.0/16) with NO internet gateway, NO NAT gateway, and NO public subnets. Service is exposed exclusively through an AWS PrivateLink VPC Endpoint Service (com.amazonaws.vpce.us-east-1.vpce-svc-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890) with 'Acceptance Required' enabled and an endpoint policy restricting principal access to arn:aws:iam::111222333444:root (the single authorized consumer account). The VPC endpoint interface ENIs reside in private subnets with a security group that only permits inbound TCP 443 from CIDR 10.100.0.0/16 (the consumer VPC range). Route tables have no 0.0.0.0/0 route. DNS is configured with a private hosted zone (products.internal.corp) resolving to the VPC endpoint ENI IPs. ElastiCache Redis cluster is in the same VPC with no public accessibility. There is no bastion host, VPN, or Direct Connect termination in this VPC.

config.network_exposure: AWS PrivateLink VPC Endpoint Service only
config.cache_backend: ElastiCache Redis 7.x, same VPC, no public access
